title: Every fibre section lifts over a pointed neighbourhood
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules on the small etale site of a scheme X [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let f:X -> Y be integral [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], let s:Spec Omega -> Y be a geometric point with Omega algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], and let (g':X' -> X,f':X' -> Spec Omega,f,s) be Cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. For a pointed etale neighbourhood (V,v), define R_(V,v):F(V times_Y X) -> Gamma(X',g'^*F) as the inverse-image unit for g' restricted along the iterated pullback lift with first projection (f' followed by v,g') and second projection the identity of X'. Every t in Gamma(X',g'^*F) has the form R_(V,v)(z) for some V,v,z.

proof.text: Obtain the module stalk-to-strict-local section isomorphism e and its representative formula from qcqs continuity. Integrality supplies the qcqs instances. Obtain the independent strict-local-to-geometric-fibre isomorphism b and its restriction formula.

The initial small-model affine pointed-neighbourhood inclusion makes the whiskered module stalk cocone a colimit. Forget modules; the forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits after universe shrinking. Types.jointly_surjective_of_isColimit gives an affine representative j,z of e.inv(b.inv(t)).

Compose the representative equation with e.hom and b.hom. The two restriction formulas identify this composite with geometricFibreSectionRestriction applied to z. Cancel the two isomorphism inverses to obtain t, and return the neighbourhood, its point and z.

proof_origin.place: Second reading P2: genuine separation of qcqs continuity from integral strict-local fibre comparison, then filtered-colimit representative extraction

theorem integralFibreSection_localLift
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f s) [IsIntegralHom f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (t : ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj.obj
      (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X')))) :
    ∃ (V : Y.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj V)
      (z : F.obj.obj (op (f.Etale.obj V))),
      (geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq.toCommSq F V v).hom z = t
